lang_usage: ℹ️ Language Settings: Usage: .botlang tr or .botlang en Current: {lang}
cat_header: 📂 {category} COMMANDS ──────────────────────── Tap a command below to inspect details and usage examples:
cmd_unban_info: Removes a user's ban from the group.
cmd_unmute_info: Unmutes a user in the group.
cmd_delme_info: Deletes the specified number of messages sent by you.
cmd_lock_info: Locks specific message or media types in the group.
cmd_unlock_info: Unlocks specific message or media types in the group.
cmd_afk_info: Activates Away From Keyboard (AFK) status with an optional custom reason.
cmd_otomesaj_info: Opens the automated scheduled messages control panel.
cmd_ilet_info: Broadcasts replied message, text, or media to all active target groups.
cmd_iletmenu_info: Lists groups with numbers to toggle broadcast targets with one click.
cmd_bypass_info: Bypasses shorteners and ad links (ouo, tinyurl, bitly, cleanuri, etc.) to get target URL.
cmd_rehbermenu_info: Opens group and contact transfer control panel with interactive buttons.
cmd_grupaktar_info: Transfers members from one group directly to another.
cmd_rehberekle_info: Saves members from a selected group into your Telegram contacts.
cmd_grubaekle_info: Bulk invites contacts from your address book into the selected group.
cmd_rehbersayi_info: Shows the total number of contacts saved in your Telegram account.
cmd_rehbersil_info: Removes a user from contacts via reply, username, or ID.
cmd_rapidapi_info: Manages RapidAPI keys for Instagram download and analysis features.
cmd_ig_info: Opens interactive button menu for Instagram stories, posts, and highlights.
cmd_yuvarlak_info: Converts replied video into a 1:1 round video note (Telescope).
cmd_ses_info: Converts replied video or audio file into a Telegram voice message.
cmd_sticker_info: Converts replied image into a standard Telegram sticker (WebP).
cmd_tts_info: Converts text to speech and sends it as a voice message.
cmd_stt_info: Transcribes voice notes and audio messages into text via Google Speech.
cmd_uninstall_info: Uninstalls a custom external plugin from memory and disk.
cmd_antidelete_info: Toggles automatic capture of deleted messages in direct messages (DM).
cmd_sureli_info: Automatically captures and saves disappearing self-destructing media.
cmd_setyedekgrup_info: Sets the default backup / archive supergroup ID.
cmd_lang_info: Changes default translation language (e.g. .dil en, .dil tr).
cmd_setalive_info: Sets or resets custom banner image for the alive card.
cmd_alive_info: Opens userbot live status card, system metrics, and control panel.
cmd_ayarlar_info: Opens interactive settings dashboard for toggling userbot features.
cmd_durum_info: Detailed diagnostic report of system hardware (CPU, RAM, Disk, Uptime).
cmd_update_info: Checks GitHub for new updates (.update) or automatically pulls and restarts (.update now).
cmd_ping_info: Measures real-time latency (ping ms) between userbot and Telegram servers.
cmd_restart_info: Restarts the userbot Python process seamlessly.
cmd_tag_info: Mentions members or administrators in a group.
cmd_ttcookie_info: Saves, clears, or shows status of TikTok account cookies for private streams.
cmd_tttakip_info: Adds a TikTok user to the automatic live stream recorder list.
cmd_tttakiptencikar_info: Removes a TikTok user from the live stream recorder list.
cmd_dil_info: Sets your default translation target language.
cmd_cevir_info: Translates replied message into your configured default language.
cmd_yt_info: Downloads media from YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, and Reddit.
cmd_tg_info: Downloads Telegram restricted media or link and sends to backup group.
cmd_whois_info: Performs detailed identity and profile analysis of a user.
cmd_ocr_info: Extracts text from images using optical character recognition (OCR).
